description: This file appears to be a PHP source file for a web application module, specifically a Wizard interface for managing email campaign marketing in SuiteCRM built on SugarCRM. It contains setup routines, UI rendering, form handling, and logic for email marketing campaign creation/editing. It interacts with database beans, templates, and manages user interaction flow.

classes.name: DotListWizardMenu
classes.description: A class responsible for generating a navigation menu for the campaign wizard steps.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user input for the email marketing campaign wizard.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML content from the SuiteEditor for rendering email templates.
